prompt:
Goal: Expand Chu-kei Insight Plan Detection from the verified 25% milestone to full company-count coverage of the canonical universe. Prioritize breadth over depth: process every company in bounded resumable batches until no company remains not_checked. Preserve evidence boundaries and never infer a formal plan where official or first-party evidence does not support one. Criteria: [1] Canonical universe coverage is complete: every company has been reviewed and the public summary reports not_checked=0, recalculated against the authoritative current universe. [2] Every non-not_checked disposition is supported by official or first-party evidence with source identity, dates or period semantics, provenance and review state; ambiguous evidence remains explicitly bounded rather than inferred. [3] Candidate generation, validation, review staging, promotion and derived registry/site rebuilds remain deterministic, resumable and compatible with required human-review gates. [4] Frontend manifest, Plan Detection summary and release metadata match canonical data, and repository-side sync, smoke, source-audit and quality checks are green. [5] Final repository and runtime verification are green and a concise completion marker records full-coverage counts, evidence boundaries and verification results. Continue from current repository state until all criteria are demonstrably satisfied; do not stop at intermediate milestones while safe executable work remains. Preserve CI, provenance, quota limits, and existing human-only review/safety boundaries. Never invent unsupported facts or bypass required review. Only after all criteria and final repository/runtime checks are green, write docs/ADE_COVERAGE_FULL_COMPLETION.json with schema_version=1,status=COMPLETE plus concise evidence. Otherwise choose the highest-value bounded next work. Declare exact new_paths for new files.
Outcome: - Rebuild canonical plan detection records in operations/plan-detection/registry-v1.json and sync dataset counts.
Scope discipline: implement only this task's stated outcome and acceptance. Do not add test code to non-test implementation files or implementation code to dedicated test files unless this task's outcome explicitly requires it.
Allowed paths: operations/plan-detection/registry-v1.json
Acceptance: - Rebuild canonical plan detection records in operations/plan-detection/registry-v1.json and sync dataset counts.; Repository CI remains green
Do not modify files outside the allowed paths.
